clips.title: The story
paras: Blackrock sentinels hold Stonewatch Tower in northeastern Redridge. Once Lakeshire's outpost, it now helps the clan watch the ridges and guard its mountain stronghold.

Stonewatch Tower rises above Lake Everstill, guarding the high mountain passes. The Kingdom of Stormwind built it as a forward scout for Stonewatch Keep. From its heights, sentries watched the eastern ridges and warned Lakeshire of threats coming from the Burning Steppes. Warlord Gath'Ilzogg's Blackrock orcs swept down from the heights, overcame the human defenders, and seized the stronghold for their war effort. Blackrock sentinels now watch the tower, keeping Alliance scouts from reaching the fortress unnoticed.
